title: Dune: A Zeroth-Order Optimizer with Time-Conditioned Historical Error Regression for VLA Test-Time Adaptation
title_zh: Dune：用于 VLA 测试时适应的时间条件化历史误差回归零阶优化器
abstract_en: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) enables Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to handle distribution shifts during deployment without source-domain retraining. However, backpropagation-based adaptation incurs heavy memory overhead on resource-constrained robots, whereas zeroth-order (ZO) methods suffer from high estimation variance under limited perturbation budgets. We observe that while ZO estimation enables low-memory adaptation with rapid initial gains, it often stalls or degrades over long-horizon updates due to noisy gradient estimates. To address these limitations, we propose Dune, a zeroth-order optimizer that stabilizes long-horizon adaptation by coupling online historical error prediction with current perturbation observations. Specifically, Dune learns a lightweight, time-conditioned error predictor from past optimization dynamics and fuses its predictions with instantaneous ZO estimates, achieving effective variance reduction without backpropagation or extra forward passes. Additionally, we theoretically characterize how estimation variance restricts convergence in high-dimensional, small-population regimes, motivating the use of historical statistics. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and real-world robots demonstrate that Dune achieves superior success rates under a low memory footprint, with ablations confirming improved closed-loop stability and post-disturbance recovery.
abstract_zh: 测试时适应（Test-Time Adaptation, TTA）让视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型无需在源域重新训练，即可应对部署时的分布偏移。然而，基于反向传播的适应方法对资源受限的机器人而言内存开销过大，而零阶（Zeroth-Order, ZO）方法在扰动采样预算有限时面临估计方差过高的问题。作者发现，零阶估计虽然能以较低内存开销快速改善初期表现，但梯度估计中的噪声常使后续更新陷入停滞，甚至导致性能下降。为此，作者提出 Dune：它利用历史优化轨迹在线训练一个轻量的时间条件化误差预测器，并将预测结果与当前扰动得到的零阶估计融合，无需反向传播或额外前向计算即可降低估计方差。论文还从理论上刻画了估计方差如何在高维、少量扰动样本的条件下限制收敛，解释了为何需要引入历史统计信息。在 LIBERO 和真实机器人上的实验表明，Dune 在保持低内存占用的同时获得了更高的任务成功率；消融实验进一步验证了其对闭环稳定性和受扰后恢复能力的改善。
key_points_zh: 零阶更新省内存、初期见效快，但扰动样本不足时，梯度估计噪声容易使持续适应停滞或退化。
Dune 在线学习时间条件化误差预测器，将历史误差预测与当前零阶估计融合，不增加前向计算次数，也无需反向传播。
理论分析刻画了高维、少量扰动样本条件下估计方差对收敛的限制，为利用历史统计信息提供依据。
LIBERO 和真实机器人实验显示，Dune 以较低内存占用取得更高的任务成功率；消融实验表明，该方法还能改善闭环稳定性和受扰后的恢复能力。
